activity.role: Lord Protector of England for Edward V before becoming king
activity.notes: Richard (Duke of Gloucester) served as Lord Protector for his young nephew Edward V in 1483 before becoming King Richard III in June. This earlier protectorship was a distinct government office, not the same reign as his 1483–1485 kingship. Exact month/day not asserted until independent official evidence confirms.
